transcript: Moving day. Spent the whole morning loading boxes into the truck with Reza's help, my arms are never forgiving me for this. Unloading at the new place took even longer because the elevator was broken, so it was all stairs, four flights, over and over. By the time we finished I basically fell onto the mattress on the floor and didn't move for an hour.
